posts.zh:
dsh-net-tools 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。让沙箱里的 agent 通过你的本地代理联网：net_fetch 抓取网页，net_proxy_status 查看代理状态。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6e49d06709bf449be8fa.html
posts.en:
dsh-net-tools is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Lets sandboxed agents reach the web through your local proxy: net_fetch fetches pages, net_proxy_status reports proxy status.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6e49d06709bf449be8fa.html
